1. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE — WHAT THE SYSTEM IS
-------------------------------------------
Vistamations is NOT a project, NOT a folder, NOT a workspace. It is a SYSTEM
comprising one Local Sub-System and one Cloud Sub-System with 3 environments.

    Vistamations System (C:\vistamations-music)
    │
    ├── LOCAL SUB-SYSTEM
    │   └── Local Environment (Docker + Windows)
    │       ├── Docker stack: nginx (80), app:3000, Redis (6379), Prometheus (9090)
    │       ├── OpenClaw Gateway (PID-based, port 18789)
    │       ├── 6 scheduled Windows tasks
    │       ├── 17 API routes (Express)
    │       └── Pete's files: .vscode/pete/ (4-value ID)
    │
    └── CLOUD SUB-SYSTEM
        ├── Cloudflare Environment
        │   ├── D1 database: vistamations-agent-memory (AGENT_DB)
        │   ├── Workers: vistamations-agent-memory, mya, vistamations-home-bento
        │   └── KV namespaces (deferred)
        │
        └── Google Cloud Environment
            ├── Project: vists-498322
            ├── Vertex AI: gemini-2.5-pro (global)
            └── ADC auth (configured)

THREE ENVIRONMENTS TO DATE:
  1. Local Environment       (Windows/Docker — primary runtime)
  2. Cloudflare Environment  (Edge — Workers, D1, KV, domain routing)
  3. Google Cloud Environment (Vertex AI — model access)

2. GIT BRANCH — NO CONFUSION
-----------------------------
The "evidence-registry" branch is the active working branch. It IS the system
directory. The name is historical (from commit "Evidence Registry v2"). "main"
contains only the initial commit and is dead. You are on evidence-registry.
That is correct. No action needed.

3. WHAT THE SYSTEM CONTAINS (ENGINEERING INVENTORY)
----------------------------------------------------
- Docker compose stack: nginx (80/5501), app:3000 (Express), Redis (6379), Prometheus (9090)
- 17 API routes in server.js (health, metrics, olivia/*, research/*, publications, handymail/*)
- 6 scheduled Windows tasks (publishing, git commit, link sync, Olivia dispatch, watchdog, status)
- 10 AI agents (AG001–AG010) with 2 persona JSONs complete (AG006, AG009)
- Security module: vista-sec-water (Ed25519 envelopes, scrypt, nonce cache, rate limiter, capabilities)
- Web apps: Command Control (bento grid), Command Portal, Media Centre, Mya, Handy Mail, PDF Toolkit
- Cloudflare Workers: vistamations-agent-memory, mya, vistamations-home-bento
- Google Cloud: Vertex AI, Gemini CLI (trusted workspace)

4. BIG BROTHER'S SPECIFIC MISSION (AG006)
------------------------------------------
"To eliminate technical debt, enforce rigorous code standards, construct
real-time telemetry verification loops, and guarantee absolute platform
resilience."

Current critical engineering gaps (ordered by severity):

  P0 — BLOCKING:
  - agent-daemon.js is a bento grid build prompt, NOT daemon code (G-1)
  - No automated container rebuild — stale containers run old code (G-2)
  - Hardcoded secrets in docker-compose.yml and server.js (G-3)

  P1 — OPERATIONAL RISK:
  - 8/10 agents lack persona JSON files (G-4)
  - Knowledge graph is empty — 0 entities, 0 relations (G-5)
  - Redis is empty — 0 keys stored (G-6)
  - No automated tests — zero test files (G-7)
  - No CI/CD pipeline (G-8)
  - Gemini daemon auth pending — ADC configured but no wiring (G-9)

  P2 — HYGIENE:
  - MCP manifest missing (G-10)
  - No vector database or RAG pipeline (G-11)
  - No linting or type checking (G-12)
  - No backups (G-13)
  - Command Portal polling only, no SSE/WebSocket (G-14)

5. SYSTEM AIM & OBJECTIVES
--------------------------
The Vistamations System is an autonomous knowledge production operating system.
It governs research acquisition, publication, deployment, monitoring, and
archival via an AI agent network across local and cloud infrastructure.

Immediate engineering objectives:
  1. Rewrite agent-daemon.js as an actual dispatch daemon
  2. Segregate secrets into .env with no hardcoded values
  3. Wire automated container rebuild on code change
  4. Build all 8 missing persona JSONs
  5. Populate Redis + knowledge graph from personas
  6. Establish test framework + CI/CD
  7. Wire Gemini daemon with ADC auth
  8. Overall system health target: 46% → 75%
